name: hollow-vault
description: ECDSA signer that sources its nonce entropy from cosmic radiation, attested by a satellite. Built for ETHPrague 2026 SpaceComputer bounty.

scripts.build: npm --workspace signer run build && npm --workspace web run build && npm --workspace cli run build
scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --test tests/payload-binding.test.ts tests/verifier.test.ts tests/batch.test.ts tests/eip712.test.ts tests/nonce-attack.test.ts tests/local-signer.test.ts tests/policy.test.ts tests/audit.test.ts tests/cache.test.ts tests/serverless-state.test.ts tests/orbitport.test.ts tests/typed-roundtrip.test.ts tests/agents-alias.test.ts tests/drand-adapter.test.ts tests/signer-edges.test.ts tests/retry.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run smoke && npm run sim:contract
